<style>
body{
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    background: #f7f5f2;
    color: #1c1a18;
    line-height: 1.7;
    font-size: 16px;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  /* ── Progress bar ── */
  #progress-bar {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    height: 3px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0d1282, #0d1282);
    width: 0%;
    z-index: 9999;
    transition: width .1s linear;
  }

  .page-wrapper {
    max-width: 800px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px 80px;
  }

  /* ── Meta top ── */
  .meta-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: 36px 0 20px;
  }
  .tag {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #0d1282;
    background: #fef3c7;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background .2s;
  }
  .tag:hover { background: #fde68a; }
  .meta-date {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #9a9490;
    margin-left: auto;
    font-weight: 300;
  }

  /* ── Title ── */
  .article-title {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(26px, 5vw, 42px);
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.18;
    color: #1c1a18;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    letter-spacing: -.02em;
  }

  /* ── Hero ── */
  .hero-wrap {
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0d1282 0%, #0d1282 50%, #0d1282 100%);
    aspect-ratio: 16/9;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
  }
  .hero-pattern {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background-image:
      radial-gradient(circle at 15% 85%, rgba(255,255,255,.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 85% 15%, rgba(255,255,255,.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
      repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent, transparent 40px, rgba(255,255,255,.015) 40px, rgba(255,255,255,.015) 41px);
  }
  .hero-inner {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 40px 32px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .hero-flag { font-size: 52px; margin-bottom: 14px; display: block; }
  .hero-badge {
    display: inline-block;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);
    color: #fef3c7;
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: .1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .hero-title {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(20px, 4vw, 30px);
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #fff;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    letter-spacing: -.01em;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }
  .hero-sub {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,.7);
    font-weight: 300;
  }

  /* ── Stats row ── */
  .stats-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
  }
  .stat-card {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e4dfd8;
    border-top: 3px solid #0d1282;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 16px 14px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .stat-card .stat-label-top {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #0d1282;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .stat-card .stat-num {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #1c1a18;
    line-height: 1.1;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .stat-card .stat-label {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #7a7470;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.35;
  }

  /* ── Critical alert ── */
  .alert-critical {
    background: #fff7ed;
    border: 1px solid #fed7aa;
    border-left: 4px solid #ea580c;
    border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0;
    padding: 18px 20px;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 14px;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .alert-critical .alert-icon {
    font-size: 20px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 1px;
  }
  .alert-critical .alert-title {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #c2410c;
    letter-spacing: .04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .alert-critical .alert-body {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #7c2d12;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .alert-critical .alert-body strong { color: #9a3412; font-weight: 600; }

  /* ── Key takeaways ── */
  .takeaways {
    background: #fff7ed;
    border: 1px solid #fed7aa;
    border-left: 4px solid #0d1282;
    border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0;
    padding: 20px 22px;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
  }
  .takeaways-title {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: .09em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #0d1282;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .takeaways ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; }
  .takeaways ul li {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #1c1a18;
    padding: 6px 0 6px 20px;
    position: relative;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #fde8c8;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }
  .takeaways ul li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .takeaways ul li::before {
    content: '✓';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    color: #0d1282;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    top: 8px;
  }

  .rule { border: none; border-top: 1px solid #e4dfd8; margin: 36px 0; }

  /* ── Body text ── */
  .article-body p {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.78;
    color: #3d3a36;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    font-weight: 300;
  }
  .article-body strong { color: #1c1a18; font-weight: 500; }

  .article-body h2 {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(19px, 3.2vw, 26px);
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #1c1a18;
    margin: 44px 0 16px;
    padding-bottom: 10px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #fde8c8;
    line-height: 1.25;
    letter-spacing: -.01em;
  }
  .article-body h3 {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(16px, 2.2vw, 19px);
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1c1a18;
    margin: 28px 0 10px;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  /* ── Callout boxes ── */
  .info-note {
    background: #fefce8;
    border: 1px solid #fde68a;
    border-left: 4px solid #ca8a04;
    border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
    padding: 14px 18px;
    margin: 16px 0 24px;
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #4a3a10;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .info-note strong { color: #92400e; font-weight: 600; }

  .success-note {
    background: #f0fdf4;
    border: 1px solid #bbf7d0;
    border-left: 4px solid #15803d;
    border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
    padding: 14px 18px;
    margin: 16px 0 24px;
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #14532d;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .success-note strong { color: #15803d; font-weight: 600; }

  .danger-note {
    background: #fef2f2;
    border: 1px solid #fecaca;
    border-left: 4px solid #ef4444;
    border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
    padding: 14px 18px;
    margin: 16px 0 24px;
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #0d1282;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .danger-note strong { color: #0d1282; font-weight: 600; }

  /* ── Visa overview cards ── */
  .visa-overview {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
    margin: 20px 0 28px;
  }
  .vo-card {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e4dfd8;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 16px 14px;
  }
  .vo-card .vo-label {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #0d1282;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
  }
  .vo-card .vo-val {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1c1a18;
    line-height: 1.2;
    margin-bottom: 3px;
  }
  .vo-card .vo-sub {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #7a7470;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  /* ── Strategy tip ── */
  .strategy-tip {
    background: #1c1a18;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 20px 22px;
    margin: 20px 0 28px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 14px;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .strategy-tip .st-icon {
    font-size: 18px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: rgba(245,158,11,.15);
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .strategy-tip .st-title {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #f59e0b;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .strategy-tip .st-body {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,.8);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .strategy-tip .st-body strong { color: #fbbf24; font-weight: 500; }

  /* ── Steps timeline ── */
  .steps-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    margin: 20px 0 28px;
    position: relative;
  }
  .steps-list::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 22px;
    top: 44px;
    bottom: 44px;
    width: 2px;
    background: #fde8c8;
  }
  .step-item {
    display: flex;
    gap: 18px;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 0 0 18px;
  }
  .step-item:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
  .step-num {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    background: #0d1282;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #fff7ed;
  }
  .step-body {
    flex: 1;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e4dfd8;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }
  .step-body .step-title {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1c1a18;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .step-body .step-badge {
    display: inline-block;
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 500;
    background: #fff7ed;
    color: #0d1282;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    letter-spacing: .04em;
  }
  .step-body .step-desc {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #4a4540;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .step-body .step-desc strong { color: #1c1a18; font-weight: 500; }
  .step-inset {
    background: #fafaf9;
    border: 1px solid #e4dfd8;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    margin-top: 12px;
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #4a4540;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .step-inset strong { color: #0d1282; font-weight: 600; }

  /* ── Document checklist ── */
  .doc-checklist { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin: 20px 0 28px; }
  .doc-item {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e4dfd8;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 14px;
    align-items: flex-start;
    transition: box-shadow .2s;
  }
  .doc-item:hover { box-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(180,83,9,.08); }
  .doc-item .doc-check {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    background: #fff7ed;
    border: 1.5px solid #fed7aa;
    border-radius: 6px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #0d1282;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-top: 1px;
  }
  .doc-item .doc-body { flex: 1; }
  .doc-item .doc-name {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1c1a18;
    margin-bottom: 3px;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  .doc-item .doc-detail {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #6b6560;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .doc-item .doc-tag {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-self: flex-start;
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 3px 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    letter-spacing: .04em;
    white-space: nowrap;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }
  .doc-tag.mandatory { background: #fef2f2; color: #dc2626; }
  .doc-tag.level3 { background: #fff7ed; color: #c2410c; }
  .doc-tag.if-applicable { background: #f0fdf4; color: #15803d; }
  .doc-tag.if-loan { background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; }
  .doc-tag.critical { background: #fdf2f8; color: #9333ea; }

  /* ── Financial table ── */
  .finance-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    margin: 16px 0 10px;
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #e4dfd8;
  }
  .finance-table thead tr { background: #1c1a18; }
  .finance-table th {
    padding: 12px 16px;
    text-align: left;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 16px;
    letter-spacing: .05em;
    color: #fff;
  }
  .finance-table tbody tr { border-bottom: 1px solid #e4dfd8; transition: background .15s; }
  .finance-table tbody tr:hover { background: #fff7ed; }
  .finance-table tbody tr:last-child { background: #fff7ed; border-bottom: none; }
  .finance-table td { padding: 12px 16px; color: #3d3a36; font-weight: 300; }
  .finance-table tbody tr:last-child td { font-weight: 600; color: #1c1a18; }
  .finance-table td:last-child { color: #0d1282; font-weight: 500; }
  .finance-table tbody tr:last-child td:last-child { color: #0d1282; }

  /* ── Timeline table ── */
  .timeline-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    margin: 16px 0 28px;
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #e4dfd8;
  }
  .timeline-table tbody tr { border-bottom: 1px solid #e4dfd8; transition: background .15s; }
  .timeline-table tbody tr:hover { background: #fff7ed; }
  .timeline-table tbody tr:last-child { border-bottom: none; background: #1c1a18; }
  .timeline-table td { padding: 12px 16px; color: #3d3a36; font-weight: 300; }
  .timeline-table td:first-child { font-weight: 500; color: #1c1a18; width: 55%; }
  .timeline-table td:last-child { color: #0d1282; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; }
  .timeline-table tbody tr:last-child td { color: #fff !important; font-weight: 600; }

  /* ── Costs grid ── */
  .costs-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
    margin: 20px 0 28px;
  }
  .cost-card {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e4dfd8;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 16px 14px;
  }
  .cost-card .cost-label {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #7a7470;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  .cost-card .cost-amount {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #0d1282;
    line-height: 1.1;
    margin-bottom: 3px;
  }
  .cost-card .cost-note {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #9a9490;
    font-weight: 300;
  }

  /* ── GS Framework ── */
  .gs-framework { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; margin: 16px 0 24px; }
  .gs-item {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e4dfd8;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 14px;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .gs-item .gs-q {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    background: #0d1282;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
    border-radius: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    letter-spacing: .03em;
  }
  .gs-item .gs-body .gs-question {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1c1a18;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .gs-item .gs-body .gs-hint {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #5a5550;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }

  /* ── Refusal reasons ── */
  .refusal-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 14px;
    margin: 20px 0 28px;
  }
  .refusal-card {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e4dfd8;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 18px 16px;
    transition: box-shadow .2s, transform .2s;
  }
  .refusal-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.08); transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .refusal-card .rc-icon {
    font-size: 22px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    display: block;
  }
  .refusal-card .rc-title {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #0d1282;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  .refusal-card .rc-desc {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #5a5550;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* ── Bullet lists ── */
  .article-body ul {
    padding-left: 0;
    margin: 12px 0 22px;
    list-style: none;
  }
  .article-body ul li {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #3d3a36;
    font-weight: 300;
    padding: 8px 0 8px 22px;
    position: relative;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e4dfd8;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .article-body ul li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .article-body ul li::before {
    content: '→';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    color: #0d1282;
    font-size: 16px;
    top: 10px;
  }

  /* ── Pullquote ── */
  .pullquote {
    border-left: 3px solid #0d1282;
    margin: 28px 0;
    padding: 18px 24px;
    background: #fff7ed;
    border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0;
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
    font-size: 17px;
    font-style: italic;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #0d1282;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  /* ── Quick ref dark panel ── */
  .quick-ref {
    background: #1c1a18;

    <p>Applying for the Australia Student Visa (Subclass 500) from Nepal in 2026 is still very much achievable — but it now requires a level of preparation that is significantly higher than it was even twelve months ago. Understanding the changes, planning ahead, and preparing every document with honesty and precision is the difference between approval and refusal.</p>

    <p>In this complete guide, Admizz Education walks you through every step of the process — from researching your course all the way to receiving your visa and preparing for departure. Read it carefully, follow it honestly, and if you need support at any stage, our team in Kathmandu is here to help.</p>

    <h2>What Is the Australia Student Visa Subclass 500?</h2>

    <p>The <strong>Student Visa Subclass 500</strong> is the standard visa that allows international students to study full-time at a CRICOS-registered institution in Australia. Issued by the Australian Department of Home Affairs (DHA), it is the only visa category under which Nepali students can enroll in an Australian degree, diploma, certificate, or English language course.</p>

    <p>Once granted, the Subclass 500 allows you to stay in Australia for the full duration of your enrolled course — and it comes with significant practical benefits, particularly when it comes to work rights and post-study pathways.</p>

        <div class="st-body">Nepal sits at Assessment Level 3 (high risk). However, combined application risk is calculated by cross-referencing both your country level and your institution's compliance level. If you apply to a <strong>Level 1 public university</strong>, your overall risk profile is meaningfully reduced compared to applying to a Level 2 or 3 private college.     <h2>How to Apply for Australia Student Visa from Nepal — 10 Steps</h2>

    <p>The application process for the Australia Student Visa has ten clearly defined stages. Each step builds on the previous one, and skipping or rushing any stage is one of the most common causes of delays and refusals. Work through each step carefully and in order.</p>

    <div class="steps-list">

      <div class="step-item">
        <div class="step-num">01</div>
        <div class="step-body">
          <div class="step-title">Research Your Course and Choose a CRICOS-Registered Institution</div>
          <span class="step-badge">Start here — 18+ months before intake</span>
          <div class="step-desc">Every institution and course that accepts international students in Australia must be listed on the <strong>CRICOS register</strong>, searchable at cricos.education.gov.au. Only CRICOS-registered courses are eligible for the Subclass 500 visa — there are no exceptions. Consider course relevance to your career goals in Nepal, location (regional study adds post-study work rights), the institution's compliance level, and realistic cost of living in that city.</div>
          <div class="step-inset">🎯 <strong>Level 3 Strategy:</strong> Apply to a Level 1 public university to reduce your overall risk profile. Private colleges at Level 2 or 3 face maximum document scrutiny when combined with Nepal's Level 3 country status.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step-item">
        <div class="step-num">02</div>
        <div class="step-body">
          <div class="step-title">Appear for Your English Proficiency Test</div>
          <span class="step-badge">Book 8–12 weeks before applying</span>
          <div class="step-desc">Under Assessment Level 3, English proficiency scores are now <strong>mandatory for all Nepali student visa applicants</strong> — regardless of previous English-medium schooling. There are no exemptions. Accepted tests include IELTS Academic, PTE Academic, and TOEFL iBT. Standard minimums are IELTS 6.0 overall (bachelor's) and IELTS 6.5 (most master's programs), with no band below 5.5 or 6.0 respectively.</div>
          <div class="step-inset">⚠️ <strong>Important:</strong> IELTS General Training is NOT accepted for university courses. You must sit <strong>IELTS Academic</strong> specifically. Book your test first — it has the longest lead time of any document.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step-item">
        <div class="step-num">03</div>
        <div class="step-body">
          <div class="step-title">Build and Document Your Financial Evidence</div>
          <span class="step-badge">Start 3–6 months before applying</span>
          <div class="step-desc">Financial documentation is, without question, the <strong>single most scrutinized element</strong> of a Nepali student's visa application under Level 3. You must demonstrate genuine, verifiable access to funds covering: first-year living expenses (minimum AUD 29,710), full first-year tuition fees, OSHC health insurance, and return travel costs. Combined, this typically totals <strong>AUD 55,000–70,000</strong> (approximately NPR 55–70 lakhs). Funds must have been maintained for at least 3–6 months before applying.</div>
          <div class="step-inset">🚫 <strong>Common Refusal Trigger:</strong> Never submit fabricated, altered, or inflated bank statements. Under Level 3, the DHA cross-checks financial documents with far greater precision. Fraudulent documents result in immediate refusal, a <strong>three-year ban</strong>, and possible criminal consequences.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step-item">
        <div class="step-num">04</div>
        <div class="step-body">
          <div class="step-title">Apply to Your Chosen University and Receive Your Letter of Offer</div>
          <span class="step-badge">2–8 weeks processing time</span>
          <div class="step-desc">Submit a complete application with your academic transcripts, certificates, English test scores, and any additional documents required by the specific course. Once assessed, the institution will send you a <strong>Letter of Offer</strong>. Review this carefully — ensure your name is spelled exactly as it appears in your passport, and that the course name, start date, and duration are all correct.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step-item">
        <div class="step-num">05</div>
        <div class="step-body">
          <div class="step-title">Accept Your Offer and Receive Your Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE)</div>
          <span class="step-badge">Most critical single document</span>
          <div class="step-desc">After accepting the Letter of Offer and paying the tuition deposit (typically the first semester's fees), your institution will issue an electronic <strong>Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE)</strong>. The CoE is arguably the most critical single document in your application — you literally cannot submit a Subclass 500 application without it. Double-check every field — your full legal name, CRICOS provider code, course code, and start/end dates — against your passport before proceeding.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step-item">
        <div class="step-num">06</div>
        <div class="step-body">
          <div class="step-title">Purchase Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC)</div>
          <span class="step-badge">Mandatory visa condition</span>
          <div class="step-desc">Every student on a Subclass 500 visa is required to maintain <strong>OSHC for the entire duration of their stay</strong> in Australia. OSHC is not optional — it is a visa condition. Purchase from one of the DHA-approved Australian providers: <strong>Medibank, Bupa, NIB, CBHS, or AHM</strong>. Coverage typically costs AUD 500–700 per year for a single student. Coverage must start from your arrival date and end on or after your CoE end date.</div>
          <div class="step-inset">💡 <strong>Family Coverage:</strong> If your spouse or children will accompany you, they must also be covered by OSHC. Adding a spouse requires an additional <strong>AUD 10,394</strong> and each child requires an additional <strong>AUD 4,449</strong> in financial evidence.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step-item">
        <div class="step-num">07</div>
        <div class="step-body">
          <div class="step-title">Write Your Genuine Student (GS) Statement</div>
          <span class="step-badge">Most important element under Level 3</span>
          <div class="step-desc">The <strong>Genuine Student (GS) statement</strong> replaced the previous Genuine Temporary Entrant (GTE) test. It is answered directly within the ImmiAccount visa application form — not as a separate uploaded document. Under Assessment Level 3, case officers read GS statements with considerably more scrutiny than before January 2026. A generic, vague, or clearly copied statement is now one of the leading causes of visa refusal — even when finances and academic records are strong.</div>
          <div class="step-inset">🚫 <strong>Do Not:</strong> Copy-paste a template from the internet, use AI-generated content verbatim, or write vague statements like "I want to gain international experience." Case officers in 2026 are specifically trained to identify all of these.</div>

          <div style="margin-top: 14px;">
            <div style="font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #0d1282; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 10px;">GS Writing Framework</div>
            <div class="gs-framework">
              <div class="gs-item">
                <div class="gs-q">Q1</div>
                <div class="gs-body">
                  <div class="gs-question">Why this course?</div>
                  <div class="gs-hint">Link the course to your specific academic and professional history. Reference your SLC/SEE grades, +2 subjects, or bachelor's degree and how they connect to your chosen field.</div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="gs-item">
                <div class="gs-q">Q2</div>
                <div class="gs-body">
                  <div class="gs-question">Why Australia and this institution specifically?</div>
                  <div class="gs-hint">Explain what makes this specific university the right fit — course structure, faculty, industry connections, or research facilities unavailable in Nepal.</div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="gs-item">
                <div class="gs-q">Q3</div>
                <div class="gs-body">
                  <div class="gs-question">What are your career plans after study?</div>
                  <div class="gs-hint">Describe a specific career path in Nepal. What sector? What role? What gap does this qualification fill that no Nepali institution can currently provide?</div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="gs-item">
                <div class="gs-q">Q4</div>
                <div class="gs-body">
                  <div class="gs-question">What are your ties to Nepal?</div>
                  <div class="gs-hint">Mention family, property, employment history, or business commitments that create genuine, convincing reasons to return to Nepal after graduation.</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step-item">
        <div class="step-num">08</div>
        <div class="step-body">
          <div class="step-title">Create Your ImmiAccount and Lodge the Application Online</div>
          <span class="step-badge">immi.homeaffairs.gov.au</span>
          <div class="step-desc">All Australian visa applications are lodged through the DHA's online portal, <strong>ImmiAccount</strong>. Create an account using your personal email — not your institution's email, as you will need access for years after your application. Upload all supporting documents, pay the visa fee of <strong>AUD 2,000</strong> by credit or debit card, and save your <strong>Transaction Reference Number (TRN)</strong> as proof of lodgement.</div>
          <div class="step-inset">⚡ <strong>Before You Submit:</strong> All documents are clear and readable · Documents in Nepali include certified English translations · Your name is spelled consistently across every document · No document has expired · Your OSHC start date aligns with your planned arrival date.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step-item">
        <div class="step-num">09</div>
        <div class="step-body">
          <div class="step-title">Complete Your Medical Examination and Provide Biometrics</div>
          <span class="step-badge">1–2 weeks after lodgement</span>
          <div class="step-desc">After lodging, you will receive a <strong>HAP ID (Health Assessment Portal ID)</strong> from the DHA. Use this to book your medical examination at a DHA-approved panel doctor in Kathmandu — approved clinics include International SOS Nepal. The examination typically includes a general health check, chest X-ray, and blood tests. Results are sent directly to the DHA by the panel doctor. You may also be required to provide biometrics (fingerprints and photograph) at <strong>VFS Global Nepal</strong> in Kathmandu.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step-item">
        <div class="step-num">10</div>
        <div class="step-body">
          <div class="step-title">Await the Decision and Prepare for Departure</div>
          <span class="step-badge">4–12 weeks processing under Level 3</span>
          <div class="step-desc">Monitor your application status through ImmiAccount. The DHA may contact you requesting additional documents (a <strong>Section 56 request</strong>) — respond promptly and completely. Once your visa is granted, read every condition carefully — your visa will specify the earliest and latest entry dates, work rights, and any other conditions. Then book your flights, arrange accommodation, and attend a pre-departure briefing.</div>
          <div class="step-inset">🛫 <strong>Pre-Departure Checklist:</strong> Review all visa conditions · Book flights within the allowed entry window · Arrange accommodation (homestay, student housing, or rental) · Carry OSHC membership card · Carry CoE and visa grant notice both digitally and in print · Inform your institution of your arrival date.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>

    <h2>Complete Document Checklist — Australia Student Visa from Nepal (2026)</h2>

    <p>Every item marked as <strong>Mandatory</strong> must be included in your application. Missing even one document can cause significant processing delays or an outright refusal. Prepare this checklist in advance and verify each item before lodgement.</p>

    <div class="doc-checklist">
      <div class="doc-item">
        <div class="doc-check">✓</div>
        <div class="doc-body">
          <div class="doc-name">Valid Passport</div>
          <div class="doc-detail">Must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your intended stay in Australia. Name must match all other documents exactly. Renew before applying if nearing expiry.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="doc-tag mandatory">Mandatory</div>
      </div>
      <div class="doc-item">
        <div class="doc-check">✓</div>
        <div class="doc-body">
          <div class="doc-name">Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE)</div>
          <div class="doc-detail">Issued electronically by your CRICOS-registered institution after you accept your offer and pay the tuition deposit. You cannot lodge a Subclass 500 application without this.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="doc-tag mandatory">Mandatory</div>

    <p>Understanding why visas are refused is just as important as understanding the application process itself. Under Assessment Level 3, the threshold for refusal is lower than it has ever been for Nepali applicants.     <div class="faq-list">

          <span class="faq-arrow">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="faq-answer">Assessment Level 3 is the highest risk tier under Australia's Simplified Student Visa Framework (SSVF), effective January 8, 2026 for Nepali students. It means your application will be examined with the maximum level of scrutiny available. Specifically, it now requires: mandatory English proficiency scores for all applicants (no exemptions), 3–6 months of verifiable bank statements, a detailed and personalized Genuine Student (GS) statement, and — in some cases — a phone or in-person interview with a DHA case officer. Importantly, Assessment Level 3 does not mean Australia is closed to Nepali students. It simply means the documentation bar is higher. Genuine, well-prepared applicants continue to be approved every day.</div>
      </div>

For most courses, this means a total of AUD 55,000–70,000 (approximately NPR 55–70 lakhs at current exchange rates). If your spouse is accompanying you, add AUD 10,394. For each child, add AUD 4,449. These funds must be evidenced through 3–6 months of consistent bank statements from a recognized Nepali commercial bank — sudden large deposits without a documented source are a major refusal trigger under Level 3.</div>

          <span class="faq-arrow">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="faq-answer">The Genuine Student (GS) statement replaced the old Genuine Temporary Entrant (GTE) requirement in 2024. Unlike the GTE, it is answered directly within the ImmiAccount visa application form using structured questions. It asks you to explain why you chose your specific course and institution, how the qualification connects to your academic and professional background, what your career plans are in Nepal after graduation, and what your ties to Nepal are. Under Assessment Level 3, a weak, vague, or copied GS statement is one of the leading causes of visa refusal — even when finances and academic records are strong. Your GS answers must be specific, personal, and genuinely written by you.</div>

To be safe, apply at least 4–6 months before your intended course start date. Applying fewer than 3 months before your intake under Level 3 is a significant risk.</div>

Australia's national minimum wage is AUD 24.95 per hour, meaning a working student can realistically earn AUD 1,000–1,400 per month during semester, which significantly offsets living costs.</div>

Only courses and institutions listed on the CRICOS register are eligible for the Subclass 500 visa — if you enroll in a course at a non-CRICOS-registered institution, you cannot apply for a student visa. You can search the register at cricos.education.gov.au.</div>

Costs are also typically lower in regional cities compared to Sydney or Melbourne.</div>

In most cases, you have the right to seek a review through the Administrative Appeals Tribunal (AAT) within the timeframe specified in your refusal notice. However, reviews are costly and time-consuming — prevention is far preferable to appeal. If you are refused, the most important step is to understand exactly why, address those specific issues, and reapply with a strengthened application. These are not difficult requirements for a genuinely motivated student. They are simply demanding ones.</p>

    <p>Furthermore, Australia's commitment to international education remains strong. The <strong>295,000-place National Planning Level for 2026</strong>, the continued availability of the Subclass 485 post-study work visa, and the 48-hour work rights during semester all demonstrate that Australia wants genuine students — it simply wants to ensure they are exactly that.</p>
